M2 VERB: skip v2 on the room's verb, POOLED over seeds 1-20 (the median over the exercised seeds; the per-set ratios printed beside it), prints a ratio >= the room's mainBar (written from its red: max(1.25, red + 0.20)) with >= 14 of 20 seeds exercised, the refusal fired and the refused run NOT using the verb on any exercised seed; **STYLE: the verb-aware run's STYLE above DULL >= the refusal's - 5 points** (FORGE69: NIGHT68's min(refusal + 15, max(refusal, 95)) asked 91-94 % on levels 3 / 5 where the verb runs reach 79-82 %: unreachable; the new rule says the verb must not make the run duller; it is written here, before any measurement); a ride room whose ratio is in [mainBar, mainBar + 0.10) is UNSURE and does not PASS M2 (so a ride room needs 1.35); on the fresh seeds 21-30 the median ratio >= 1.25 and >= 7 of 10 exercised

M3: the room's verb pilot GREEN on line65 (ride: a kill from the wall, `n65verb ride --shoot`; launch: 'in a pit yes' or 'in lava yes' on the launched body; parry: a returned glob kills a spitter; slide: the slide line's kill; pierce: >= 2 bodies)

M4: every piece of the rebuilt room passes the decoration checker (its base the room file's first commit), and at least one collider piece was added with a job; a round's change counts only by a double-or-half (a piece added or removed, or one geometry number x2 / x0.5); **a rebuilt room keeps at most 25 % of the shipped room's pieces** (`node Tools/night/n69-patch-share.cjs --level <L> <id>`: geometry-equal boxes, ramps, pads and pits of Design/levels/n67/<L>/rooms-base/<id>.json: gg-proxy's #1 'the old room with a patch'; inside the slot's fixed rect and doors), and it keeps every verb and every pad / ride face the shipped room offered unless the card says what replaces it (nothing the player had is lost: air65's flights handed on)

GUARDS, no worse than the shipped room (its red; the ceilings in this slate: deathsAMax, deathsBMax, stallAMax): the walk bot (n46flow seeds 1-10 and 11-20) clears 10 / 10, deaths A / B and stall A at or under the ceilings; no room-check item fails that passed in the shipped room; air65's flights handed on; levelgen ERROR rows no more than the base level's own; the room's spawn never moved toward the verb's line
